common_configuration.actor_information: own standard aircraft observation plus remaining-time fraction
common_configuration.navigation_prior: Goal/reference-bearing tracking before learned heading offset

progress_shaping.formula: gamma * next_potential - current_potential; terminal potential is zero

common_configuration.finite_horizon: Do not bootstrap beyond goal completion or the actual 3000-second competition deadline; bootstrap at rollout cuts.
common_configuration.action_distribution: SB3 diagonal Gaussian; clip sampled latent actions to [-1,1] before the recorded action mapping
common_configuration.action_mapping: Heading: observed reference bearing plus learned +/-90 degree offset, wrapped and clipped to +/-45 degree turn; speed increment unchanged
common_configuration.active_mask: Policy, value, entropy and advantage-normalization samples exclude inactive aircraft slots
common_configuration.critic_fit_diagnostic: Live rollout samples only; collected value predictions versus GAE targets, before optimization
common_configuration.budget_unit: Live aircraft transitions; finish the current rollout, recording exact overshoot and padded slot count

limitations: This extends nine completed cells after their outcomes were known; it is a retrospective exploratory completion, not a prospectively registered twelve-run confirmatory study.
The filter flag enables the existing combined static-area and aircraft-conflict filter. This factorial does not isolate traffic filtering from static filtering.
Goal-offset actions retain goal/reference-bearing tracking even with route guidance off; g0-f0 is not a navigation-prior-free controller.
Three 100k-live-transition seeds per cell, two simulator workers and Gaussian exploration; findings do not establish behavior of the newer gSDE recipe.
All development worlds have been reused. No reserved or official scenarios are used.
Training supports change trajectories and observed experiences even with paired generator seeds; compare outcomes at matched live budgets and full initial tensors.
The fixed classical controller differs from the initial policy, including its speed command. It is retained as context, never tuned.
World bootstrap intervals are conditional on the observed training seeds; they are not training-population confidence intervals.
Across-seed sample standard deviations summarize only three training seeds.
All physical metrics and contrasts are exploratory; no multiple-testing-adjusted significance or general algorithm ranking is claimed.
